title: Benchmark Mismatch Test (Real Video)
scriptText:
[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
A dramatic cinematic thriller sequence where a lone operative picks up an encrypted briefcase on a dimly lit street corner while the camera pushes in dramatically.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Strict camera continuity. Maintain forward dolly translation on character approach. Prop permanence for briefcase.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
35mm film stock, high contrast chiaroscuro, amber tungsten practicals with deep indigo shadows.
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[OPENING]]
Medium-wide establishing shot of an urban crosswalk under streetlamps.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] Forward camera dolly-in onto subject -> [ACT] Operative reaches down and picks up metallic briefcase -> Operative says {The drop is secure.} -> <Heavy metallic latch click>
[CAM 02] Extreme close-up on operative eyes -> [ACT] Operative glances nervously over right shoulder -> <Low tension bass drone>
[</BRIEF>]
